Argo 的功能「wide/research」：并行研究：规划互补研究轨道、调度子代理、汇总来源账本并生成报告。 由 DSH 工具或 provider 调用。
Argo 的功能「settings/panel」：设置面板：调整原生工具、搜索入口、并发和研究上限等插件配置。 由 DSH 工具或 provider 调用。

argo-search README · 这是什么：**Argo 是一个装在 Agent 里的搜索与深度研究工具，也可以获取相关网页的信息。背后连着 286 个搜索源，覆盖 99 个业务领域，同时支持本地文件的基础搜索能力。在开源搜索项目里，具备非常强大的搜索能力。**

支持配置 API Key 提升搜索质量（配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过），也支持免费引擎和本地引擎自动保底。覆盖中英日韩等 18 种语言，支持金融、学术、影视、体育、代码、宏观等垂直场景。

argo-search README · 子技能：Argo 的能力通过四个子技能（sub-skills）组织，每个子技能是一条独立可用的管线：

| 子技能 | 能力 |
|--------|------|
| **local-search** | 本机文件搜索 + 本地零成本聚合引擎（32 个本地引擎）。搜代码符号、文件名、文档全文、文件结构。可并入网络搜索结果，加一个开关本机命中就并进同一次搜索 |
| **local-seek** | 本地语义搜索（BM25 + 向量混合），搜笔记、记忆、资料库。三层递进：先定位文件、再看上下文、最后精读段落 |
| **ego-search** | 登录态专业搜索。知乎、小红书、公众号等需要登录才能看的内容，用真实浏览器配合登录态去搜。默认关闭，需时开启 |
| **js-run** | 无浏览器执行网页 JS。不开浏览器跑「环境探测 + 纯计算」型网页脚本，单次上下文 P50 约 1ms |

四个子技能覆盖了从「搜本机」到「搜全网」到「搜登录墙后面」的完整链路。大部分场景用 local-search + 联网搜索就够，特殊场景再开 ego-search 和 js-run。

argo-search README · DSH 插件：Argo 同时是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，一行命令装好：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add argo-search                  # npm 发布版
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo"      # GitHub main
```

装完重启 `dsh web` 即生效。搜索和抓取成为原生一等工具，不依赖 MCP 连接，不占常驻上下文开销。另有 1 个 `wide_research` 并行研究和 19 个 MCP 工具按需开启。完整接入形态见下文。

argo-search README · 三种调用通道，一套能力：| 通道 | 默认 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| **原生一等工具** | 开 | `argo_search` / `argo_fetch` 等经 `ctx.tools.register` 注册，走 CLI 单发（`--call`）复用 MCP 同一套引擎与守卫，**不依赖 MCP 连接、零常驻 token 开销** |
| **原生 web seam** | 开 | 注册 `argo` 搜索与抓取两个 provider，宿主内置 `web_search` 路由到 argo 引擎链、`web_fetch` 走 argo 抓取链（HTTP 优先，遇 Cloudflare / JS 渲染自动升级反检测浏览器） |
| **MCP 形态** | 按需 | 19 个 `mcp__argo__*` 完整工具面。工具定义每轮注入上下文且压缩清不掉（实测 19 工具 ≈3.7K token/轮），而高频路径已由原生工具与 web seam 覆盖，故默认不挂载；需要长尾取证能力时在 profile patch 中取消 `mcp-argo` 行注释 |

**密钥安全**：写入 DSH 凭证库（与 Models 页同一处），不写进插件配置、不打日志、不回显明文。凭证服务优先级为**存储文件层 > 启动环境 > 项目 .env > 家目录 .env**：在面板（或 Models 页）保存即覆盖启动环境里的旧值，argo 子进程下一跳新连接用新 key；「清除」只删凭证库里的值，环境变量或 `.env` 提供的 key 会重新露出。设置页只是凭证域的写入口，读取仍由宿主在每次调用时完成。

**本地搜索 + 联网搜索一体。** 这是 Argo 独一份的能力。本机文件搜索底层是 rg、mdfind 那套开发者日常工具，搜代码符号、文件名、文档全文、文件结构。加一个开关，本机命中会并进同一次网络搜索结果里，结果上标着来源是本机文件。写东西时记得自己半年前记过一段话但忘了在哪，用这个搜比翻文件夹快。

**双层缓存，热查询约 10ms。** 时效性没那么强的内容（百科类、历史数据这类），第一次查完会进缓存，之后同样的查询直接命中，不再每次都走一遍 API。既省钱也省时间。

**多语言 + 垂直场景。** 实测过 18 种语言，中文、英文和日文能查到当地一手来源。问论文走学术库，问影视走条目库，问代码走问答社区，问行情走金融源。泛泛的问题才走通用搜索。

argo-search README · 七种能力，通俗说：**1. 通用搜索 + 垂直搜索，双管齐下**

日常问题走通用网页搜索；一问到行情、影视、体育、宏观这类「有标准答案」的问题，自动切到垂直源直接给答案，而不是扔给你一堆链接。目前 286 个源（240 个免密钥开箱可用）、99 个业务域，金融 / 宏观 / 影视 / 体育 / 地理 / 组织 / 媒体 / 化学 / 学术 / 代码等都有专门的路。

**2. 缓存：不重复花冤枉钱**

时效性没那么强的内容（百科类、历史数据这类），第一次查完会进缓存，之后同样的查询直接命中，不再每次都走一遍 API。双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级返回，既省钱也省时间。

**3. 专为 Agent 设计，更省 Token**

产出是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」的精简 JSON，不是长篇网页；MCP 响应可以按需裁剪，snippet 可控，不会撑爆 Agent 的上下文。比常规模型自带的搜索能力更专业、更省 Token。

**4. 深度研究**

把一个笼统的问题拆成多个子问题，多源并行采集，最后给出「还差什么证据」的缺口提示。适合综述、调研这类要全面、要扎实的场景。

argo-search README · 七种能力，通俗说：**5. 登录态专业搜索（专业模式，默认关闭）**

知乎、小红书、公众号这类要登录才能看的内容，以及 JS 渲染页、反爬页，用真实浏览器配合登录态去搜。默认关闭，需要时开启，依赖 ego lite 和 WebBridge 两个东西，详见下节「登录态专业搜索」。

**6. 时间能力（时间窗 + 方向排序）**

要搜「最近几天刚发布的内容」，用 `--since 7d` 这类时间窗框住发布时间范围，判断新旧不再靠猜。支持引擎（如 `realtime_index`，免 Key 实时索引源、需自装 CLI，结果自带发布时间）把窗口下推给数据源；其余引擎的融合结果会按 `published_at` 最后再剔除明确超窗的条目（宽松策略，无时间字段的保留），返回包带 `time_filtered` 统计，CLI 与 MCP 均支持。`--since 7d` 与「7 天前的绝对日期」等价、共享缓存；`--until 2026-08-01` 含当天。配合 `--sort newest|oldest` 按发布时间重排——找最新动态用 `newest`，找最早出处用 `oldest`。

argo-search README · 七种能力，通俗说：**7. 在 DSH 里当原生工具用**

装成 DSH 插件后，搜索与抓取是宿主的一等工具，不是外挂的 MCP 连接：`argo_search` / `argo_fetch` 直接可调，宿主的 `web_search` / `web_fetch` 也自动路由到 argo 的引擎链与抓取链。高频路径零常驻 token 开销，长尾取证能力（截图 / PDF / 社交 / 公众号 / 招聘 / 结构化提取 / 证据核验 / 意图消歧 / 站点爬取 / 批量预检 / 变化监控 / DOI 引用 / 本机检索）按需勾选开启。改配置不用碰文件——设置页六个分区改完即生效，密钥写进宿主凭证库、明文不回显。详见上文「DSH 插件」。

text: argo-search README · Built-in settings page: six sections, effective on save：**Key security**: keys are written to the DSH credential store (the same place as the Models page) — never into plugin config, never logged, never echoed. Credential resolution priority is **stored file layer > startup env > project .env > home .env**: saving in the panel (or the Models page) overrides older startup-env values, and the argo subprocess picks up the new key on the next new connection; Clear only deletes the credential-store value, so keys supplied by env vars or `.env` reappear. text: argo-search README · Built-in settings page: six sections, effective on save：**DeepSeek official key, supplied natively**: argo's `deepseek_search` engine (the official `api.deepseek.com/v1/tools/search`, whose results carry authority levels / rerank scores / publish times) **shares one key with DSH's official search backend**. The plugin obtains it through DSH's native credential seam, so no manual configuration is needed: resolution is `ctx.get('credentials').resolve('DEEPSEEK_API_KEY')`, resolved per call — after rotating the key on the web Models page the next new connection uses it, with no plugin restart. argo-search README · Evidence scoring (short)：```
selection  ≈ domain authority; SERP / redirect shells ranked very low
absorption ≈ density of numbers / definitions / comparisons / disclosures
freshness  ≈ publish time (ignores historical comparison years like “since 2015”)
composite  ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·engine score

Results include `selection`, `absorption`, `credibility_fast`, `evidence_flags`, etc. so agents can sort directly.

argo-search README · Agent discipline (recommended)：1. **High-stakes questions** (positions, safety, “is this true?”): search → read fast scores → `fetch` top hits → then conclude

3. **SERP / redirect pages**: never treat as primary sources  
4. **Social posts**: sentiment and narrative, not ground truth  
5. **Fact-check**: prefer a few stratified queries (source / comparison / subject)

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：What Argo does, in one sentence: it sends each question to the right sources by domain and language, ranks what comes back by credibility, and hands the agent material it can sort and verify. Search, fetch, evidence checking and local file search share one pipeline, the 19 MCP tools map one-to-one onto CLI commands, so nothing is missing whichever form you install. A few standalone commands round it out: argo tweet packs an X post, argo auth handles login state, argo job aggregates job listings. The full catalog, with cost, key and status per source, sits in docs/ENGINE_CATALOG.md: **286 sources (240 usable with no key), 99 domains**.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：Installed as a DSH plugin, these capabilities become native host tools: the hot-path search and fetch are on by default, the long-tail forensics tools toggle on in the settings page, and argo's own 28 behaviour switches (cache, rerank, dedup, guard, proxy, TTLs and the rest) moved out of environment variables and into the panel. Keys go into the host credential store, are never echoed, and every change takes effect on save.

The last few releases each fixed one class of problems.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.11.2 focuses on closing external feedback. It adds SauceNAO, AnimeTrace, and Google Lens as explicit-only reverse-image engines and removes the dead tineye; fixes four silent-failure classes — keyRefs credentials never reaching subprocesses (key-needing engines no longer return skipped-missing-env), quota not self-healing on key rotation and 402 wrongly locking 30 days, and social-engine subprocess env / credential forwarding; and routes lint_spec_contracts through the shared YAML loader, clearing main's unit/extras shard failures.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.10.2 focuses on semantic routing and the test foundation. Relevance anchor weighting and a static concept vector table landed; a 13-case human-labeled route set plus an executability gate raised labeled accuracy from 76.9% to 100% — principle/explainer queries no longer fall into academic libraries and platform-guide queries no longer trigger social listening. 123 of 201 routing-snapshot decisions (61%) moved from tfidf scoring to regex/concept direct-match, faster and more assertable. The circuit-breaker factory now resolves at call time, so the same module loaded from different paths no longer keeps separate breaker states. Snippet tag hygiene and caliber dedup join output assembly. The three-tab ZCode panel landed, and ARGO_* env vars are snapshot-restored per test case, closing sporadic ordering pollution. Concept semantic routing is off by default; enable with ARGO_CONCEPT_ROUTER=1.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.10.1 focuses on routing precision consolidation and community issue fixes. It introduces the declarative @commercial_market intent exclusion macro to prevent pharma commercial queries (market size, volume-based procurement, revenue) from falsely hijacking bioinformatics databases like UniProt (#34.1); adds a keyless overseas video lane via parallel_free with site:youtube.com and strips YouTube tracking params (#34.3); eliminates the local-seek zero-match double-run tax, surfacing missing-tool warnings and prioritizing SQLite FTS5 (#34.4); adds url_kind: none support for URL-less specs and guards against empty placeholder bare prefix dead links (#29); fixes engine_status unknown engine reporting and cleans up orphan specs (#29, #34.6); and decouples the nightly drift gate by removing automatic baseline auto-commits (#35).

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.10.0 widens the capability surface. Sources grow from 272 to 284: five Metaso tiers (scholar, library, image, video, podcast), Sciverse records, NCPSSD Chinese social science, plus three DSH plugin catalogs and two skill indexes — the skill sources carry install counts for the first time. Video works end to end, from query to fetch: a new video domain with --video, duration filters, Bilibili subtitles on fetch and YouTube timedtext. The crawl chain gained frontier quality control and polite pacing — per-host rate limits, 429 backoff — and watch now separates noise from substantive change. General source selection uses measured ordering, English general queries get a conditional DeepSeek hedge, and response bodies go through one decoder with JSON-LD. The installer takes the venv path, so PEP 668 environments no longer end up without their dependencies.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.9.9 is a security-and-delivery-quality release. The content-security engine used to score web content but not stop it: a high-risk injection page went straight into the pipeline. Now anything over the risk threshold is quarantined, the cleaned text replaces the original, and it never reaches the evidence score. The network egress gains two layers of defense: redirects are validated hop by hop, and the resolved address is pinned to the connection, closing the DNS-rebinding window. On the dispatch side, results from slow engines abandoned by early-stop are no longer thrown away: they are collected in the background, delivered as usual if they finish within the grace window, and their real performance finally reaches the learner. A six-family scan of real-world scenarios tightened five classes of mis-routing: A-share financial queries, corporate due-diligence / invoicing / person-to-company lookups, civil-law practice, drug leaflets and paper-writing how-tos all land where they should. New this round: `argo engine add` wires a new engine up in one step, and the DSH settings page gains a route-observation card with tool recommendat

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.9.8 is a routing-precision and feedback-loop release. The three problems in issue #18 — "latest" being routed into realtime news, people_daily returning its default feed when nothing matches, and local_bing matching only "2026" — were all reproduced and fixed. Replaying real queries along the same lines tightened 16 more classes of false triggers: "snow" inside brand names, "Volcano Engine" inside product names, UI-troubleshooting "icons", "code" inside business/finance field names, and "exchange rate" inside code/library queries. A SERP coverage gate and CJK cross-validation now stop "it returned something" from counting as "it is relevant". Thanks to @wpp666 for the reproduction and diagnosis.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.9.7 fixed three long-standing ones. When an AI inside a DSH host asked to read a URL, the host used its own fetcher, so short-link redirects and JS challenge pages often failed outright while argo's fetch chain sat unused; this release wires the host's reads through argo, and those pages go from failing to succeeding, with static pages unchanged. The routing candidate pool used to hold 18 explicit-only engines, and if one was ever auto-selected the only paid engine would quietly bill you; the pool is clean now, and using them requires saying so. Every engine success used to take a file lock and rewrite breaker state on disk; healthy engines now cost zero file I/O, and multi-engine accounting commits in one transaction. The license also moved from MIT to Apache-2.0, which sits easier with commercial users.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：After that the DSH plugin gained another layer: the settings page grew from five sections to six, the new "Engines" section brings argo's behaviour switches into the panel (they used to be env-var only), the keys page now shows whether each key comes from the credential store, the startup environment or `.env`, and tool toggles, timeouts, concurrency and research caps all apply on save. Cancellation now reaches the connection-establishment stage too — when the AI stops mid-flight, an argo subprocess that is still being spawned is killed immediately instead of waiting out its timeout.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.9.6 handled query operators and the transport layer. A query like site:github.com foo used to have its operator treated as a plain word, or parsed but never applied; a contract layer now strips operators before routing and caching, applies site: as a real filter, and folds it into the cache key, so two searches don't bleed into each other. On transport, every POST used to re-pay the TLS handshake, 320 to 561 ms of it; with connections pooled, a resident MCP process saves that on every query. This release also added the official DeepSeek search engine, billed per call and kept out of the everyday combos.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.9.5 added FX rates and tightened dedup. Asking for the USD/CNY rate used to spin through the macro domain and land on an encyclopedia entry, 1.4 s with no answer; a dedicated fx domain now answers in 675 ms with the live rate and daily news. Dedup gained site-suffix normalization and a fuzzy second pass, so official docs with separators in the title stop getting pushed to the back.

argo-search README · Rough capability set (v2.11.2)：v2.9.4 fixed the explicit-engine path. Pinning --engine X used to get a blanket cache TTL; with domain determination in place, the TTL follows the domain, and a missing fallback engine no longer triggers an empty re-run of the same engine.
